summary: Beyond the original SAHPRA recall, Nigeria's NAFDAC issued a public alert referencing the same Citro-Soda Regular recall, noting that all batches with batch numbers starting with 'C' and expiring on or before November 2027 are affected. No other international regulator or credible news source reported additional distinct findings beyond these alerts.
